//: Composite indexes, deployed with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes
Firestore builds single-field indexes on its own. A query filtering on one
field and ordering by another needs one of these, and will fail loudly
with a console link if it is missing. They are written here rather than
clicked, so the query and the index it needs live in the same repository.
Scope COLLECTION rather than COLLECTION_GROUP on purpose: notes are read
one session at a time, and a collection group query would need a
match /{path=**}/notes rule, which is the database-wide wildcard that
firestore.rules opens by refusing to have.

indexes.//: listNotes and syncNotes' full read: one book, in the order written.
syncNotes' incremental read: one book, changed since a watermark.
